theorem BGramApplications.actual_zeroth_Gram_application.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (chi : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (c : ℝ≥0∞),
  c ≠ 0 →
    Measure.map (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K) mu = c • volume →
      ∀ (z : ι → ℂ),
        Function.Injective z →
          ∀ (a s alpha : ℝ),
            (∀ (i : ι),
                MemLp (Masullo.GenuineNormalizedMellinJet.genuineNormalizedMellinJet K chi (z i) a s alpha 0) 2 mu) →
              IsUnit (Masullo.ActualGram.actualGram K mu (fun x => chi) z a s alpha fun x => 0).det ∧
                Masullo.GramDualPairingIntegrable.JetClosed K (fun x => chi) z fun x => 0 :=
fun K [Field K] [NumberField K] {ι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] mu chi c hc hmap z hz a s alpha hg =>
  ⟨Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => IsUnit (Matrix.det _a))
          (Eq.symm (BGramApplications.actualGram_eq_L2_Gram K mu (fun x => chi) z a s alpha (fun x => 0) hg))))
      (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
        (ne_of_gt
          (Matrix.PosDef.det_pos
            (Matrix.posDef_gram_of_linearIndependent
              (Masullo.RadialExpHom.native_zero_L2_independent K chi mu c hc hmap z hz a s alpha hg))))),
    fun i k hk =>
    have hk0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk;
    Exists.intro i ⟨rfl, ⟨rfl, Eq.symm hk0⟩⟩⟩

theorem BGramApplications.actual_fullJet_Gram_application.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] {J : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Fintype J] [inst_3 : DecidableEq J]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (chi : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (c : ℝ≥0∞),
  c ≠ 0 →
    Measure.map (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K) mu = c • volume →
      ∀ (z : J → ℂ),
        Function.Injective z →
          ∀ (N : J → ℕ) (a s alpha : ℝ),
            (∀ (i : (j : J) × Fin (N j)),
                MemLp (Masullo.GenuineNormalizedMellinJet.genuineNormalizedMellinJet K chi (z i.fst) a s alpha ↑i.snd) 2
                  mu) →
              IsUnit
                  (Masullo.ActualGram.actualGram K mu (fun x => chi) (fun i => z i.fst) a s alpha fun i => ↑i.snd).det ∧
                Masullo.GramDualPairingIntegrable.JetClosed K (fun x => chi) (fun i => z i.fst) fun i => ↑i.snd :=
fun K [Field K] [NumberField K] {J} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] mu chi c hc hmap z hz N a s alpha hg =>
  ⟨Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => IsUnit (Matrix.det _a))
          (Eq.symm
            (BGramApplications.actualGram_eq_L2_Gram K mu (fun x => chi) (fun i => z i.fst) a s alpha (fun i => ↑i.snd)
              hg))))
      (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
        (ne_of_gt
          (Matrix.PosDef.det_pos
            (Matrix.posDef_gram_of_linearIndependent
              (BGramApplications.native_fullJets_L2_independent K mu chi c hc hmap z hz N a s alpha hg))))),
    BGramApplications.fullJetFamily_closed K (fun x => chi) z N⟩

theorem BGramApplications.actual_strip_Gram_application.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] {J : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Fintype J] [inst_3 : DecidableEq J]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (chi : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (c : ℝ≥0∞),
  c ≠ 0 →
    c ≠ ⊤ →
      Measure.map (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K) mu = c • volume →
        ∀ (z : J → ℂ),
          Function.Injective z →
            ∀ (N : J → ℕ) (a s alpha : ℝ),
              0 ≤ s →
                0 ≤ alpha →
                  (∀ (j : J), |(z j).re - a| ≤ alpha) →
                    have n := fun j => BGramApplications.stripJetCount (z j) a s alpha (N j);
                    IsUnit
                        (Masullo.ActualGram.actualGram K mu (fun x => chi) (fun i => z i.fst) a s alpha fun i =>
                            ↑i.snd).det ∧
                      Masullo.GramDualPairingIntegrable.JetClosed K (fun x => chi) (fun i => z i.fst) fun i => ↑i.snd :=
fun K [Field K] [NumberField K] {J} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] mu chi c hc0 hct hmap z hz N a s alpha hs ha hstrip =>
  id
    (BGramApplications.actual_fullJet_Gram_application K mu chi c hc0 hmap z hz
      (fun j => BGramApplications.stripJetCount (z j) a s alpha (N j)) a s alpha
      (BGramApplications.strip_fullJet_memLp K mu chi c hc0 hct hmap z N a s alpha hs ha hstrip))
'BGramApplications.actual_strip_Gram_application' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'BGramApplications.actual_strip_Gram_application' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
BGramApplications.actual_strip_Gram_application.{u_1, u_2} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] {J : Type u_2}
  [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (chi : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K)
  (c : ℝ≥0∞) (hc0 : c ≠ 0) (hct : c ≠ ⊤) (hmap : Measure.map (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K) mu = c • volume)
  (z : J → ℂ) (hz : Function.Injective z) (N : J → ℕ) (a s alpha : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha)
  (hstrip : ∀ (j : J), |(z j).re - a| ≤ alpha) :
  have n := fun j => BGramApplications.stripJetCount (z j) a s alpha (N j);
  IsUnit (Masullo.ActualGram.actualGram K mu (fun x => chi) (fun i => z i.fst) a s alpha fun i => ↑i.snd).det ∧
    Masullo.GramDualPairingIntegrable.JetClosed K (fun x => chi) (fun i => z i.fst) fun i => ↑i.snd
